reason: My usual workshop gives me a price on WhatsApp in a minute and I already know the man who does the work. I do not know ArmorHub or its partners, and a website that finds strangers for my BMW is not something I would hand my car to in my first month.
objection: I do not know who these partners are. ID and commercial registration checks sound fine on paper, but I have not met anyone and I would have to trust a stranger with a car that is worth more than my week's salary.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or family member who has used ArmorHub and had good work done, so I hear it from someone I know rather than from an app.
